correctness.rationale: The \(2^{16}\) exhaustive reversible five-window feedback parametrization is proved bijective with rooted order-five cycles, independently corroborated by exhaustive rooted Euler tours. For each of 2048 cycles, independent polynomial root-multiplicity/Games–Chan computations agree on L, independent signed-dot/XOR computations agree on every periodic correlation; all 60 table entries, the 32 populated cells, marginal checks and three exact complement/reversal orbits are verified using the enclosed executable and proof. This is a finite theorem only.

value.rationale: The complete two-invariant classification of a canonical 2048-cycle binary family determines simultaneous feasibility and multiplicity of maximal linear unpredictability and minimal periodic autocorrelation, a direct selection problem motivated by prior independent studies. Eight out of twelve optimum-sidelobe sequences also attain L=31; exactly three reversal-complement orbits describe all twelve. This precise joint count is not recoverable from existing marginals, is not an arbitrary length-parameter increment and is a reproducible finite benchmark; no physical-layer benefit is inferred.
